en.headline: Two public-housing tenants jailed over undeclared flats
en.dek: The Housing Department said tenants in Choi Hung and Kwong Tin estates were convicted after failing to declare homes they owned when filing income and asset forms in 2025.
body: The Housing Department said two public-rental tenants have been jailed after being convicted of falsely declaring that they owned no property, in breach of the Housing Ordinance.

A spokesman said the cases involve tenants of Choi Hung Estate and Kwong Tin Estate. When they completed income and asset declaration forms in 2025, neither declared ownership of a Hong Kong property. After investigation, the department found that two Choi Hung tenants each owned homes in Sai Kung — one person two flats, the other one. Kwun Tong Magistrates' Courts on Monday sentenced the tenant who owned two flats to two weeks in jail, to be served immediately. The other tenant is due in court on 30 November, and the department will recover the public-rental flat.

In the Kwong Tin case, the tenant owned one residential property in Tseung Kwan O and was sentenced to four weeks in jail, with bail pending appeal. The department said public-housing residents and subsidised-housing applicants must declare income, assets and property truthfully, and that it would keep using several measures against abuse of public housing.

zh.headline: 兩公屋住戶虛報無物業 被判監禁
zh.dek: 房屋署說彩虹邨及廣田邨兩宗個案的住戶，2025年填報入息及資產時沒有申報本港物業，罪名成立後被判監。
body: 房屋署發言人表示，兩宗個案的兩名公屋居民因虛報沒有物業，違反《房屋條例》，罪名成立，被判監禁。
涉案住戶分別居於彩虹邨及廣田邨。他們在2025年填寫入息及資產申報表時，均沒有申報擁有香港物業。署方調查後發現，彩虹邨個案的兩名住戶各自在西貢擁有住宅，一人擁有兩個單位，另一人擁有一個。觀塘裁判法院星期一判處擁有兩個物業的居民監禁兩星期，即時執行；另一人下月30日提堂，房屋署將收回涉案公屋單位。
廣田邨個案的住戶擁有一個將軍澳住宅物業，被判監禁四星期，獲准保釋等候上訴。房屋署提醒公屋居民及資助房屋申請人必須如實申報入息、資產及物業，並會繼續打擊濫用公屋。
